{{Quote|The Academy at Sab Rufo, from which Rin claims to hold two doctoral degrees (and at which he claims to be the current Director of Sentientology), is nonexistent.|Major Herrit, Imperial communique #46553.27h|<ref name="GG4" />}}
The '''Director of Sentientology''' was a position in the [[Academy at Sab Rufo]] that, according to the credentials of the [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]], he held by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] performed a background check on Rin, whom the Empire had commissioned to [[Author/Legends|author]] a [[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy|reference work]] detailing the various [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Herrit subsequently sent [[Imperial Communique 46553.27h|communique #46553.27h]], addressed to<ref name="GG4" /> the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="CSWE Vader">{{CSWECite|III|288|Vader, Darth}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], in which the major criticized Rin and<ref name="GG4" /> erroneously<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref> claimed that the Academy at Sab Rufo&mdash;or indeed [[Sab Rufo]] itself&mdash;did not in fact exist. In a [[Imperial Communique 46553.28v|reply communique]], Vader's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Solistein]] dismissed Herrit's "unsolicited opinions" and, in response to the latter's criticisms of Rin's qualifications, only stated that Vader had not ordered Herrit to perform a background check on the sentientologist.<ref name="GG4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The position of Director of Sentientology was mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook authored by [[Troy Denning]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG4" />
